title: Online Info Day: EIC Accelerator Challenges 2027
summary: A morning online session presenting the four challenge areas of the EIC Accelerator in 2027.
details: Commission and EIC programme managers present each challenge in turn: in-situ ocean observation technologies, climate-neutral and smart cities, enabling technologies for fusion power plants, and carbon removal and utilisation. It runs from 09:00 to 12:30 CET in English and follows the general EIC info day held the day before.
Registration closes on 19 November 2026 at 10:00 CET. Questions can be sent in advance through Slido.
why: Companies whose technology sits in one of these four areas may find a challenge a better route than the open Accelerator. The session is the best place to test that fit before drafting.
